title: createStore
subtitle: Create a state store
description: Creates a new store instance. Re-exported from qortex-store for convenience.
content: The `createStore` function creates a new store. You can pass a raw object for simple state, or an initializer function that receives `set` and `get` to define complex actions and computed state.

signature.code:
createStore<T>(
  initializer: T | StateCreator<T>,
  options?: CreateStoreOptions<T>
): Store<T>

rows.name: initializer
rows.description: Either a raw initial state object or a function that receives set and get and returns the initial state object.

rows.name: options
rows.description: Optional configuration for the store, including persistence.

returns.description: A store instance with get, set, subscribe, and destroy methods
